text:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight 'Inference Cost Advisor' that bundles batching, caching, and quantization recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Short outline below, want quick takes.

mira: Love the idea. For rollout, can we scope MVP to hosted first? Also need acceptance criteria before we commit.

alex: MVP thoughts: real-time suggestions for observed request patterns -> recommended batch size, prefix cache TTL, and a recommended quantization profile for each model variant. Acceptance criteria: recommendations must show >=10% median token cost reduction for at least 2/3 pilot customers without increasing 95th percentile latency by >5%.

sam: How do eval-triggered alerts weave in? We need to avoid alert fatigue / false positives.

alex: Eval alerts plan: wire route-level evals (small curated prompt-sets) to monitor quality drift. If regression > threshold, send alert + automated rollback suggestion (e.g., revert quantized variant -> full-precision). Gate rollout on 3 customer eval sets + internal smoke tests.

dev-bot: reminder: add metric hooks for per-route token-cost, prefix-hit-rate, effective-batch-size, and per-variant quality score.

joni: Implementation note — runtime needs to expose kv-cache hit rate and effective batch sizes. Can eng-runtime emit these in response headers or a sampling endpoint?

sam: Also, quantization guardrails: some model families degrade on 4-bit. We should require an automated A/B compare on a small sample before recommending auto-apply.

mira: Customer ask we've heard: they want explicit 'suggest' vs 'auto-apply' behavior. Default to suggestion in UI, opt-in auto-apply for Dedicated/reserved customers.

alex: Agreed. Pilot plan: three customers (PLG, mid-market, Dedicated enterprise). Timeline: prototype in 6 weeks, 8-week pilot run. Success metrics: cost reduction, false-alert rate <10%, zero customer-reported regressions above acceptance threshold.

joni: :thumbsup: I'll scope runtime hooks. One open question: can we compute per-request optimal batch size without adding coordinator latency? That could be the main engineering risk.

alex: We can approximate from sliding-window latency distribution + current queue length; only compute heavy optimizer periodically and fall back to conservative suggestions if uncertain.

sam: Gating checklist to add: data-privacy review for eval uploads, E2E tests for fallback behavior, rollback playbook. Legal signoff needed for any auto-apply on Dedicated.

mira: I'll draft the launch gate doc and acceptance checklist. If no objections, I'll add it to next roadmap review slot.

alex: No objections from me. @sam @joni can you take task owners for A) evaluation alert thresholds + A/B pipeline and B) runtime signal hooks respectively? I'll start pilot onboarding template and ping product-ops.

sam: Taking A.

joni: Taking B — will post a short PRD for runtime metrics tomorrow.

alex: Thanks team. Small follow-up: keep suggestions readable in the UI — show estimated cost delta and risk note (latency/quality tradeoff).
